_comment: John - Conversational, even more energetic and faster Shorts delivery (test 2026-11-05). Based on profiles/john_shorts.json (not changed); only stability differs. Pause shortening and loudness are done locally afterwards (voice-lab/2026-11-05_v3-test/fast_john_shorts.py); the take's voice.wav stays unprocessed.

elevenlabs._voice_id_note: Found 2026-11-05 via GET /v2/voices?search=John (exactly one match among 27 voices) and confirmed with GET /v1/voices/OEHTkiHZj6OczWZHu0Aj: HTTP 200, category 'professional' (PVC), status 'copied', no verification needed, notice period 730 days.
elevenlabs._model_note: John is fine-tuned for eleven_v4 (and multilingual_v2, turbo/flash), not for eleven_v3. Same model as the Buster test for a fair comparison.
elevenlabs._voice_settings_note: Stability 0.2 (previous test 0.35, John's default 0.50): even more expressive. Speed cannot be set in Eleven v4; the spoken file starts with the delivery instruction [energetic, fast-paced].

postprocess._note: Natural, no effects: no pitch, no formant processing, no tempo change, no EQ, no loudness change. With pitch 0 and tempo 1.0 process_voice.py skips Rubber Band; only the format conversion MP3 -> 48 kHz / 24-bit mono WAV remains.
